blocks.text: The portfolio strategy work for {{fact:f:E-2019-002.client}} is moving on schedule, and I wanted to line up the last of the data we need before the picture goes any wider. We have the market and competitive read well under way, and Melissa Casey has finished a first pass on the business-by-business profiles, which are holding up against what we heard from you at the outset.

The gap now is on the internal numbers. Three of the schedules we asked for, the ones behind the two largest of the businesses, have not yet reached us, and without them Melissa Casey cannot close the comparison across the portfolio. If you can have them to us by the middle of next week, we can keep the review on its timeline rather than presenting around a hole in it.

I would also like to hold a short working session to walk you through what the read is showing before we take it any further. For that session I have you, Barbara Ward, Melissa Casey, and myself, Steven Hunt; let me know a day next week that suits you and I will hold it and send a short agenda round once the date is fixed.
